pages.title: Supramolecular Chemistry
pages.text: $(thing)Supramolecular Chemistry$()$(br2)Molecules that build themselves into cages, frameworks and machines. Unlocks MOFs, clathrates and self-healing polymers.

$(thing)Insight$(): 60$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Nanochemistry, Topological Matter.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Graphene Sheet.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A host cage and a guest molecule bind in solution. The binding releases enthalpy but costs entropy, as both lose freedom. Write the association constant (per molar concentration) from the enthalpy change, the entropy change and the temperature.
